fields.question: How should I promote my referral program?
fields.answer:
If nobody knows about your referral program, then it won't be a success. When you launch your referral program, you should design a strategy to promote the program to your customers: make it __easy to discover__ by placing it in highly visible places, make it __easy to find__ when people are seeking it out, and __target happy moments__ in your customer journey.

A good place to start is our [Promoting Your Referral Program Webinar](https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/recording/4633109273020290561).
